text: Calculates and reports tax even on payments processed outside Stripe
quote: Calculate and report tax on all payments, even those that you process outside of Stripe.

text: Calculates sales tax, VAT, and GST worldwide based on product type and customer/business location
quote: Calculate sales tax, VAT, and GST for transactions worldwide, determining tax rates based on product type, customer location, and business location.

text: Can calculate tax specifically on shipping costs via a dedicated parameter
quote: To calculate tax on shipping costs, use the `shipping_cost` parameter

text: Can geolocate customer IP to estimate tax before postal address is provided
quote: If you provide your customer’s IP address, we geolocate it and use that location as your customer’s location. Use this to show your customer a tax estimate before they provide their postal address.

text: Supports a ship-from address so tax is calculated from actual shipping origin
quote: If your business ships goods from locations other than your head office, you can provide a ship-from address to calculate tax based on the actual shipping origin.

text: Offers a sandbox to preview automatic tax calculation behavior for different settings
quote: You can use Stripe Tax in a sandbox environment to preview automatic tax calculation behavior for different tax settings.

text: Identifies jurisdictions where you may need to register based on past transaction history
quote: Identify where you might need to register to collect tax based on past transactions.

text: Lets you register to collect tax as soon as you start processing payments
quote: Register to collect tax as soon as you start processing payments.

text: Supports no-code tax calculation and collection on a payment page
quote: Learn how to calculate and collect tax on a payment page without writing any code.

text: Integrates with TaxJar to automate US sales tax return filing
quote: Stripe Tax integrates with TaxJar to automate filing for US sales tax, helping you file on time and avoid errors that can occur with manual filing.

text: Provides itemized exports with line-item level tax breakdown for every transaction
quote: Itemized exports contain a detailed view of the line item level tax breakdown for every transaction.

text: Applies a preset product tax code automatically when a product has no tax code set
quote: Stripe Tax uses the preset product tax code for products that don’t have a PTC set directly.

text: Returns the reasoning behind each tax result via a taxability_reason API field
quote: The API returns the reason for a tax result in the taxability_reason field.

text: Can register for tax collection on your behalf
quote: You can also use Stripe to register on your behalf.
